sections.title: CURRENT TRAINING BLOCK W2/4
sections.description:
Welcome to week 2 of our current training block Team,
If you just joined the team, make sure to read below:

I encourage you to watch the block explanation video below that will give you a deep insight into how the program is structured from a macro to micro level (Global-->Weekly-->Daily overview). 
Video link (block explanation): https://youtu.be/eEDBjjL9vdQ

If you do not have the time to watch the block explanation video, you can as always read the detailed notes attached in each section of the program to understand the intent behind everything. Due to FITr's layout, we have added the text as attachments to have less text in each box.

Our goal with this training program is to have you feel:
a. Constant progress through consistent good training weeks.
b. Feeling good (injury free)
c. Motivated and driven as you see and understand the intention of how the program is structured.

Our training principles to have success with the program:
#1 If you want to be good at something, you must above all else,
be consistent.
#2 Minimum Effective dose: This is a principle that we use to underline the concept of more frequent good training sessions leads to better results long term. Often if we train too hard we also need a longer recovery time before we can train hard again. Rather keep 5% in the tank instead of overreaching. Typically, people who do not take the needed recovery time from the sessions where they did more than they should end up injured/hits a plateau. We do not need to go to the maximum every time to create adaptation. 
#3 Self-regulation: Listen to your body and adjust the intensity based on how you feel.
#4 Consistently good rather than occasionally great: Many good sessions are always better than a few great. 
#5 The devil is in the detail: Be deliberate and pay attention to set up/reps/tempo/intensity described in the program. 
#6 Stay in your lane: Don’t get caught up in anybody else’s game, you focus on you and your progress.
#7 Technique > Load
#8 Quality > Quantity
#9 Principles > Methods
--------------------------------------
Have a great training block team,
/𝙰𝚗𝚍𝚛𝚎 𝙷𝚘𝚞𝚍𝚎𝚝
𝙳𝚒𝚛𝚎𝚌𝚝𝚘𝚛 𝚘𝚏 𝚃𝚛𝚊𝚒𝚗𝚒𝚗𝚐.
𝚗𝚜𝚝.

sections.title: S1: WARM UP - Snatch
sections.description:
Weightlifting, Warm up 

a. General prep  
4 min Row (Easy-Moderate tempo)
-Into-
1-2 rounds of:
15 DB Cuban Press (2x7.5-10/4-6kg | 2x15-25/10-15lbs)
1 minute Wall sit hold

b. Specific prep
8 Snatch Grip RDL + 8 High Hang Snatch Pulls (Empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
8 Good-mornings + 8 Behind the neck Snatch grip press (Empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
5+5, 4+4, 3+3, 2+2, 1+1* reps of:
Muscle Snatch + BTN Snatch grip push press (Increasing load as reps decrease)

*Flow explained
5 Muscle Snatch directly into 5 BTN Push press.
Add weight.
4 Muscle Snatch directly into 4 BTN Push press.
Add weight.
3 Muscle Snatch directly into 3 BTN Push press.
Add weight.
2 Muscle Snatch directly into 2 BTN Push press.
Add weight.
1 Muscle Snatch directly into 1 BTN Push press. 
My numbers for reference: 40-50-60-70-75kg

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH-SPEED (Snatch)
sections.description:
Strength-Speed / "Power" / Weightlifting, Power Snatch

a. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
3 (1.1.1) Power Snatch (67.5-77.5% of 1RM = @67.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH-@77.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH)

b. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
2 (1.1) Power Snatch (72.5-82.5% of 1RM = @72.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH-@82.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH)

c. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
1 Power Snatch (77.5-87.5% of 1RM = @77.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH-@87.5%1RM_POWER_SNATCH)

d. (Optional Speed/Power-Endurance)
Elite:
1 minute on / 30 sec off until you have accumulated 10 rounds of:
25 Double Unders (Heavy rope)
5 Power Snatches (43/29kg │ 95/65lbs)

RX:
1 minute on / 30 sec off until you have accumulated 8 rounds of:
25 Double Unders
5 Power Snatches (43/29kg │ 95/65lbs)

Intermediate:
1 minute on / 30 sec off until you have accumulated 6 rounds of:
25 Double Unders or 60 Single unders
5 Power Snatches (43/29kg │ 95/65lbs)

Progression:
W1: 3 sets of 3 reps, 3 sets of 2 reps, 3 sets of 1 rep + Optional barbell cycling work
W2: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads. (+2.5% from last week) (Current)
W3: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads.
W4: Transition week

1.1.1: This means the reps are performed as singles (drop and go) and not touch and go.
----------------------------------
Read more about how weightlifting is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: ABSOLUTE STRENGTH (Squat)
sections.description:
Strength, Anterior Lower-body (Squat)

a. 6 sets, Going every 3rd minute
Set 1, 4: 6 Back Squats
Set 2, 5: 4 Back Squats
Set 3, 6: 2 Back Squats

(Optional) Absolute Speed add-on: After each set perform:
Option #1: 3 Seated Jumps to box.
Option #2: 15m Sled push sprint. 
Option #3: 3 Paused DB squat jumps (2x10/7.5kg │ 2x25/15lbs)

Load: Wave load format. Suggested loads below:
Set 1: 6 reps at 65% of 1RM (@65%1RM_BACKSQ)
Set 2: 4 reps at 75% of 1RM (@75%1RM_BACKSQ)
Set 3: 2 reps at 85% of 1RM (@85%1RM_BACKSQ)
Set 4: 6 reps at 70% of 1RM (@70%1RM_BACKSQ)
Set 5: 4 reps at 80% of 1RM (@80%1RM_BACKSQ)
Set 6: 2 reps at 90% of 1RM (@90%1RM_BACKSQ)

Tempo: Controlled descent, No Pause in the bottom, As aggressive and strong upwards as possible. Rest as needed in the top. (20X1)

Progression:
W1: 7-5-3-7-5-3 Back Squats
W2: 6-4-2-6-4-2 Back squats (Heavier than last week) (current)
W3: 5-3-1-5-3-1 Back squats (Heavier than last week)
W4: Transition week.
----------------------------------
Read more about how strength is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH ENDURANCE (Press/Pull)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance, Anterior + Posterior Upper-body (Press/Pull)

Elite:
a. 2 sets, Rest 3 minutes between 
3 rounds of:
10 Double DB Bench press (2x32.5/22.5kg │ 2x70/50lbs)
10 Strict Chin ups

RX:
a. 2 sets, Rest 3 minutes between 
3 rounds of:
10 Double DB Bench press (2x22.5/15kg │ 2x50/35lbs)
8 Strict Chin ups

Intermediate
a. 2 sets, Rest 3 minutes between 
3 rounds of:
10 Double DB Bench press (2x17.5/12.5kg │ 2x40/30lbs)
6 Strict Chin ups (Banded)

Tempo: Quality and control is key.

Flow explained: 
3 rounds of Bench press and Chin ups.
Rest 3 minutes.
Repeat.

Intent: Improve muscle endurance qualities in pressing and pulling exercises.
----------------------------------
Read more about how strength is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: (OPTIONAL) STRENGTH ACCESSORY (Core)
sections.description:
(Optional) Strength Accessory, Core

a. 5 sets, Going every 90 sec (no rest between sets)
Set 1: 30 Anchored Sit ups + Plank in the remaining time
Set 2: 25 Anchored Sit ups + Plank in the remaining time
Set 3: 20 Anchored Sit ups + Plank in the remaining time
Set 4: 15 Anchored Sit ups + Plank in the remaining time
Set 5: 10 Anchored Sit ups + Plank in the remaining time

(No load on the sit ups)

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning, Run - “Raising the ceiling” (Threshold │ 80-85% effort │ Heavy-Severe intensity domain │ Z3-4)

a. Warm up
(Part 1) Locomotion pre-run routine (see video) 
1 length Walk on toes
1 length  Walk on heels
1 length  Walk on toes
1 length Walk on heels
2 lengths Heel to toe roll
1 length Forward pogos
1 length Side ways pogos
1 length Side ways pogos (other side)
1 length Back wards pogos
1 length Kenyan pogos 
1 length Kenyan Forward Knee raises (Right leg)
1 length Kenyan Forward Knee raises (Left leg)
1 length Kenyan Side Knee raises (Right leg)
1 length Kenyan Side Knee raises (Left leg)
(1 length = 7.5m / 25ft)

b. 3 sets, 
10 minute AMRAP / Rest 5 minutes
200m Run
10 Line facing Burpees
100-200-300-400m etc. Ski erg
Intensity: "Raising the ceiling" (80-85% effort / “Threshold” / Highest repeatable effort / Heavy-Severe Intensity domain / Z4.)
